verdicts.reason: A: the two-line headline is jammed against the top and bottom edges, and a large dead gap sits between the phone and the text. The 'Back by Demand' badge is the same size as the CTA and stacked directly above it, so it competes with the CTA. 'Summer Only' is stranded on its own with empty space to its right, and the subline is tiny. B: the one-line headline, subline, badge pair and CTA form a cleaner, better-balanced row that reads left to right. Its flaws: the 'SOLSTICE' wordmark floats on its own next to the phone instead of sitting with the headline, the green circle is clipped at the bottom edge, and the subline and phone screen are small.
